reason: I never buy a game I haven't seen played, and here there's no video, no reviews, just a description and a box. On top of that, 45 lari for a deck of cards feels steep for a gift when I haven't played anything in over a year myself.
objection: I have no idea whether it's actually fun or just awkward: what if people freeze up for those 30 seconds and the whole evening falls flat? Without seeing real people play it, I'm not paying 45 lari.
would_change_my_mind: A video of a real group playing it and laughing, plus a few honest reviews, and ideally a price closer to 30 lari.
